g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
SS 304 (ASTM A240 / A276); tube ASTM A554 4 in sq x 11 ga
Non-contact: #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: SIDE ELEVATION, SECTION ON X = 0 (1:4), OPERATOR AT THE LEFT
drill + tap AFTER welding, from the head plate
304 4 in sq x 11 ga (101.6 x 3.05) x 936, square cut ±0.5
Tube to base plate, all round
Tube to cap plate, all round
Horseshoe to tube, 3 sides, top + bottom
1. Jig the base and cap on a column fixture: both plates square to the tube 0.3, cap ∥ base 0.5, cap holes clocked to the base holes ±0.3.
2. Horseshoe at 827 ±0.5 above the base underside, its axis 300 ±0.5 from the column axis, centred on x 0 ±0.3. Weld top and bottom alternately.
3. After welding: stress-relieve not needed. Check the cap and horseshoe against datum A with the column bolted to a surface plate; shim faces if over.
4. Calcs (P1-401-900): bending 6 MPa in the tube, tip deflection 0.27 mm; horseshoe arm 20.6 MPa and 0.32 mm with a full hopper (radial auger clearance 0.75).
